title: Catalog
description: A Catalog is the top-level registry of all available UI Components. It is the entry point of the Thermidor contract: both the backend (producer) and the frontend (consumer) reference the same Catalog to know what components exist and how they are structured. For the initial implementation, a Catalog corresponds to an A2-UI catalog.

catalogId.description: Stable kebab-case identifier for this catalog (e.g. 'a2ui-commerce-v1'). Used by both producer and consumer to identify which contract version they are implementing.

version.description: Semantic version of this catalog definition (e.g. '0.1.0'). Versioning strategy is deferred to a future ADR.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this catalog covers.

components.description: The complete set of Components registered in this catalog. Order is not significant.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema meta-annotation. Included here so that catalog documents may carry a '$schema' pointer to this schema for tooling support (IDE validation, etc.) without failing additionalProperties checks.
